about: Sukrara data field's Connect IQ store listing (docs/20-publishing.md › Connect IQ store: the listings). The texts are description-<lang>.txt (plain text, at most 4000 characters; tools/release/test_release.py counts them in UTF-8 bytes); the images are made by assets/brand/sukrara/connectiq/render.mjs into `images`: icon-500.png, hero-<lang>.png (the title and `tagline`), screen-<id>.png for each of `screenshots`, in this order. release.py's garmin step prints it for the upload.
category: Health & Fitness, or the closest the form offers
